findings.source_quote: As a child, you might think you can’t make a difference in the lives of people around you, but that is not true!
findings.suggested_fix:
In the translated opening line the article’s English phrase “As a child,” was rendered incorrectly as “As kind” (missing the Afrikaans indefinite article ’n). Replace the paragraph’s opening with:

As ’n kind mag jy dink jy kan nie ’n verskil maak in die lewens van mense om jou nie, maar dit is nie waar nie!

— preserving the existing class attribute and surrounding tags.
